gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes classifying the method used to derive an equivalent static load-displacement response from rapid (force-pulse) load test data. Used for the value of diggs:RapidLoadTestType/analysisMethod. The two named methods are the interpretation techniques both ASTM D7383 and EN ISO 22477-10 practice draw on; neither standard body treats them as specific to the other.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Rapid Load Test Analysis Method Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Derives an equivalent static load-displacement curve from the measured force-pulse and displacement data by removing velocity-dependent (damping) resistance at the point of maximum displacement, where velocity is momentarily zero. The standard interpretation method for rapid load test data.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Unloading Point Method

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A refinement of the Unloading Point Method that additionally accounts for the unloading stiffness of the ground, improving the derived static resistance where the basic method under- or over-predicts it.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Modified Unloading Point Method

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A rapid-load interpretation method other than the Unloading Point Method or its Modified form.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Other
